description: I+He_n fragment kinetic-energy reference for MD comparison

measurement_context.series_note: final production series of the day, 600 mW probe: 43634 (I+), 43635 (I+ local bg), 43636 (IHe+), 43640..43654 (IHe3+..IHe17+), 43655 (noise, MCP front 0 kV), 43656 (IHe2+). The first IHe2+ take 43637 was contaminated (accidental pump-probe; 43638/43639 are the pump-only/probe-only checks) and remeasured as 43656. 43655 was taken because 600 mW shows "substantial background for all masses"; the lab book prescribes subtracting it, which this export does (scaled per fragment).
measurement_context.crosscheck_series: independent 300 mW series measured the same day (lower intrinsic high-E background, ~half signal): 43614 (IHe17+) .. 43631 (I+), 43632 (I+ local bg). See crosscheck_300mW_series.m / IHe_KED_crosscheck_300mW.csv.

mass_gate.note: TOF mass-gate DELAY (D3) centers for n = 0..17 from the lab book (absent from the data info files); centered on the observed I+He_n TOF peaks (timetrace offset 561 ns), sqrt(m)-consistent spacing -> unit-mass selection. Gate WIDTHS were not logged.

kinetic_energy.quantity: lab-frame translational KE of the detected complex, 1/2 m(n) v^2
kinetic_energy.reconstruction: pyabel (rbasex, reg=pos) speed distribution I(r) from distr.rIbeta(): the properly v^2- and sin(theta)-weighted 3-D KED (abel_inv_post=true); NOT the 2-D slice density and NOT the projection
kinetic_energy.moment_definition: <E> = sum(E.*P(v))/sum(P(v)) on the uniform-in-r native grid = int E P(E) dE / int P(E) dE (proper dE weighting); moments from the UNSMOOTHED distribution over the signal mask
kinetic_energy.mass_independent_note: singly-charged VMI: E = 1/2*127*(r*vf)^2, native per-fragment grid (uniform in r)

frame: droplet rest frame: beam velocity removed by centering on VM_center and per-fragment recentering.

calibration.note: FLIR value; 10.0995 is the IDS value and would be wrong for fn>~2100. ~2% assumed on vf (CEI-fit precision); reference-velocity model error NOT included; coherent scale band.

central_analysis.smoothing_role: movmean (omitnan) is applied ONLY to build the signal mask (threshold + cuts); moments and sigmaKE are computed from the unsmoothed distribution, and cuts are masks (no NaN/zero smearing into neighboring bins)
central_analysis.mask_definition: signal mask = the CONTIGUOUS supra-threshold region of the smoothed normalized P(E) containing the peak (isolated supra-threshold islands at high E are residual-background artifacts with large leverage under proper dE weighting and are excluded)

systematic_ensemble.definition: sysErr = half-range of meanKE over the members below (each is a defensible pipeline; varies every analysis manipulation). NaN members omitted.

bgOffShift: bgOffShift_eV = meanKE(no global-bg subtraction) - meanKE(central). Structural sensitivity diagnostic ONLY; bg-off is a rejected method (leaves cluster high-E tails in), so it is NOT included in sysErr.

condition_systematic.origin: independent same-day 300 mW series (43614-43631) run through the identical pipeline (crosscheck_300mW_series.m / IHe_KED_crosscheck_300mW.csv): coherent +5-7% shift of all clusters (n>=2) and -6.3% for n=0 relative to this 600 mW reference
condition_systematic.meaning: between-measurement-conditions reproducibility (probe power and/or background regime); a CORRELATED envelope like calibSyst_frac, applied to all fragments together; NOT per-point scatter and NOT included in dominantError (it would tag nearly every point and hide the internal error structure)

shape_note: the cluster distributions are strongly RIGHT-skewed (n=1: mean ~ 1.4x mode, skewness ~ +1.8), while I+ (n=0) is mildly LEFT-skewed (mode ~ 4.7 eV > mean 3.7 eV). The mean is therefore NOT where P(E) peaks. This is a property of the distribution, not an uncertainty: all quoted errors refer to the MEAN. Use modeKE_eV/medianKE_eV for "typical energy" statements; compare MD to the data moment-to-moment (mean to mean), not mean-to-peak.

columns.meanKE_eV: first moment of the 3-D KED, sum(E.*P(v))/sum(P(v)) on the uniform-in-r grid (= int E P(E) dE / int P(E) dE), over the signal mask (central config); UNSMOOTHED distribution
columns.modeKE_eV: location of the maximum of the mask-smoothed P(E) within the signal mask (same movmean as the mask, no new convention); see shape_note
columns.medianKE_eV: median of the UNSMOOTHED P(E) within the signal mask (robust central value); see shape_note
columns.sigmaKE_eV: physical width (std) of the UNSMOOTHED P(E) over the signal mask; NOT the error on the mean
columns.sysErr_meanKE_eV: ensemble half-range over all analysis manipulations
columns.conditionSyst_frac: fractional measurement-condition reproducibility (multiply meanKE); correlated band, see condition_systematic
columns.total_error_guidance: per-point = sqrt(statErr^2 + sysErr^2); then apply calibSyst_frac*meanKE and conditionSyst_frac*meanKE as separate correlated bands (they shift all fragments together)
columns.N_counts: raw centroided counts in the mass gate (whole image)
columns.dominantError: largest of {statErr, sysErr, calibSyst_frac*meanKE, |bgOffShift|} in absolute eV: stat|analysis|calib|bg-structural. bg-structural means the value hinges on the global-bg choice (treat with care).
columns.noiseLimited: 1 if N_eff<100 or sys/mean>0.5 or stat/mean>0.5

curves_files.contents: trusted reference curves for the five verified low-n fragments, in BOTH representations and BOTH measures. 2d = angle-integrated radial density of the bg-subtracted, RECENTERED detector image (NOT Abel-inverted; interpolated from its 1-px grid onto the 3-D grid); 3d = pyabel rIbeta speed distribution (the corrected 3-D measure the reference moments use). _Pv columns are densities per unit SPEED (plot against v_mps); _PE columns are densities per unit ENERGY, P(E) = P(v)*dv/dE prop. P(v)/v (plot against E_eV). Plotting a _Pv column against E_eV merely relabels the axis and is NOT the energy density. CAUTION: signal_2d_PE tends to a FINITE center-fill plateau at low E (it is prop. to the ring-averaged image brightness, and the center of a VMI image is filled by fast ions projected inward) - do not read its low-E elevation as slow-ion signal; the 3d columns are immune (P(v) prop. v^2 near 0).
curves_files.normalization: each signal column INDEPENDENTLY normalized so its movmean-smoothed envelope peaks at 1 in the signal region (n=0: E>1 eV, else E>0.01 eV); columns live in different measures - compare shapes, never amplitudes across columns
curves_files.axes: E_eV = mass-independent KE 1/2*127*(r*vf)^2; v_mps = sqrt(2E/m(n)). ONE shared axis pair for both representations (Abel inversion does not remap the radius axis: shell rim in the projection = shell peak in the reconstruction). Interpretation differs: for _3d_ columns the coordinate is the TRUE speed/energy of the ion; for _2d_ columns it is the PROJECTED in-plane component v*sin(theta) / apparent energy.
curves_files.excluded_regions: 3d columns ONLY: NaN where E < 0.01 eV (n>=1) or E < 0.4 eV (n=0, Abel-center spike - an inversion artifact). 2d columns cover the full detector range (the raw projection is clean to r=0; small negatives = bg-subtraction noise). Upper end = detector/crop edge at 354 px = 6.13 eV (=3052 m/s at m=127); NOTE the on-the-day lab-book plots show the same edge at ~3576 m/s because they used the legacy velocity factor 10.0995 - same pixels, superseded calibration.

spectra_file.contents: UNSMOOTHED P(E) = P(v)*dv/dE on the common native E grid, normalized so the movmean-smoothed envelope peaks at 1 in the signal region (n=0: E>1 eV; else E>0.01 eV)
spectra_file.excluded_regions: NaN where E < lowE_cut_eV (both fragments) and where E < Iplus_cut_eV (n=0 only, Abel-spike region); rows with both signals NaN are dropped
